title: Playboy: Sensual Pleasures of Oriental Massage
original_title: Playboy: Sensual Pleasures of Oriental Massage
overview: Body and spirit are united as you and your lover share the intimacy of centuries-old massage practices based on the wisdom of Asia. The traditions of the ages in China and Japan unfold before you and become your personal ritual for sharing oneness. On this artistically produced how-to program, attractive couples demonstrate the soothing and stimulating arts of healing massage while easy-to-follow expert narration guides you through the sensuous steps of the art of touch. Featured on this program are Chinese "triple heat" massage, Japanese 'anma' and 'shiatsu' massage, the gentle flow of stretching massage and the all-consuming experience of Oriental sensual massage.
